text:
Here he passed on foot

through these streets,

without employment or post


And without a peso


Only poets, whores

But


remember him when

you have concrete bridges,


Great turbines,

tractors, silver granaries,


good governments.


The National Guard

is looking

for a man


a man hopes

tonight to reach

the border


the name

of that man

is not known


there are many

more men

buried in

a ditch


The number and

the name of those

men are not known.


Nor is the place known

or the number of ditches.


The National Guard

is looking for a man


A man hopes

tonight to leave

Nicaragua

translation.title: Here He Passed on Foot...
translation.editorial_note: The source appears fragmentary after 'Only poets, whores'; the translation preserves that break and the shift to the fugitive.
